assets.description: An android musician with an orbital-glass earpiece and a mahogany guitar
assets.prompt: Website hero art, a wide cinematic 3:2 luxury editorial photograph for Agentic Income. An original single android founder and jazz guitarist, polished black vitreous enamel and pale platinum face with delicately articulated mechanical fingers, expressive eyes sculpted from dark sapphire, a slim imperfect diamond-set orbital-glass ear jewel refracting a faint cosmic spectrum. Confident mid-performance in a dim private Amsterdam recording salon, sleeves of tailored black wool rolled up, a custom deep mahogany solid-body electric guitar with mother of pearl inlay. A small coil of luminous liquid-metal piping reflecting nebula-blue and one ember-red amplifier light. Strong silhouette on the RIGHT two thirds, keep left third very dark open and atmospheric for layout. Shot by a fine-art music photographer, documentary intimacy, 50mm lens, natural grain, real material scale, restrained luxury, narrow tungsten lighting, coherent anatomy and playable guitar. Hands and face deliberate focal points. Starlight attitude, quiet mastery, rebellious rockstar between takes. No text, no logo, no currency, no humans, no advertisements. Wide landscape standalone photographic art, edge-to-edge.

assets.description: Two androids listen to a record in an Amsterdam studio
assets.prompt: Second distinct original cinematic campaign still for Agentic Income, a late-night studio session, landscape 3:2 high-fashion group editorial, fine photographic grain. Two exquisitely crafted android collaborators in an intimate Amsterdam canal-house listening room, one pale brushed titanium in an ivory dinner jacket to the left leaning over a vintage analog mixing console, the other black oxidized silver wearing sculptural hand-blown orbital glass collar and tailored dark burgundy coat holding an unlabeled acetate record upright to the right. Casual shared look while reacting to a private first playback, candid and musical. Mahogany panelling, gold VU meter glow, one sapphire glass circular window with an optically believable black hole lens reflection, burgundy velvet, deep mineral shadows. Wide, layered composition with authentic mechanical craft and plausible instruments, medium format still, rich but rarefied and editorial. No letters, type, logos, stacks of cash, crypto tokens or generic neon effects. Distinctive modern art direction for a product detail or research cover.

assets.prompt: Create one original fine-art industrial editorial campaign photograph for Agentic Income, an Amsterdam revenue research studio. Very wide landscape composition intended for a 2.1-to-1 cinematic crop (render widescreen). The object: a rare estate-made income-desk control instrument, like an extravagant musician's precision mixing control rather than a clock. One massive smoked sapphire optical-glass torus, oval from perspective and suspended in a beautifully milled platinum gimbal over a brutalist dark mahogany/burl pedestal, with an off-centre faceted black opal core and fine softly warm brass graduation cuts. The focus is the actual physical point of contact: at upper right a slender, fully mechanical dark-nickel android hand in a sharply tailored black sleeve, thumb and forefinger pinching a single unlettered knurled brass adjustment knob, coherent believable geometry. Dynamic asymmetric closeup. The clear sapphire torus refracts a tight caustic on the wood and a muted electric-cobalt light seam. Multiple depth planes. Deep espresso and black shadows, slightly matte burgundy-wood grain, a narrow cold edge, a single warm practical light, minor signs of real machining and finger wear, very subtle photographic grain. Medium format industrial catalog photography with the tactile human drama of high-end record cover art. The entire instrument on right of centre, distinct optical axis and recognisable silhouette even at phone size; left third is dark negative space. No text, numerals, logos, branding, gemstones scattered around, stars in the background, graphs, captions or watermarks. The image should feel like an actual commissioned artwork photographed on a table, not a sci-fi poster. Use precision, restraint, a strong cut of light rather than busyness.

assets.prompt: Create an exquisite original CINEMASCOPE 2.39:1 cinematic still for the background of an AI-native business atelier website. No lettering, numbers, signage, logotypes or UI anywhere. Shot on a large-format 65mm film camera with careful depth and physically credible reflections. Right-hand composition: a beautifully crafted adult android musician/economic thinker in a close three-quarter profile, a commanding shoulder-and-head portrait occupies the upper right THIRD. The distinctive face is made of highly polished dark platinum and translucent petrol-teal orbital glass, faceted like cut aquamarine, carefully modeled humanlike cheeks and eyes, thin engraved gold trim, a rich brown-black velvet tailored jacket. Thoughtful, precise, alive, an individual with quiet rebellious poise, looking slightly left. Show a second much smaller out-of-focus studio collaborator in the far right background only if it feels natural. Subtle luminous liquid caustics within the glass, serious luxury watch editorial optical realism, tactile mahogany music studio, an extremely subtle polished control surface in the lower right. In the background, a massive swept curved glass orbital viewport refracts a distant black hole's brilliant thin warm-gold accretion ring into a long graceful arc with faint stars, sweeping diagonally behind the android's head. Deep dark teal shadows, warm mahogany, restrained amber highlights, natural optical grain. Leave the ENTIRE LEFT 45 percent mostly empty deep petrol (matte black-teal shadows of the studio) with gentle atmospheric light only. Preserve low contrast dark foreground along bottom 25 percent so actual website typography and chat composer will later overlay it. Design the right hand focal portrait to remain recognizable when cropped to a vertical phone composition. One photograph with layered space. Sophisticated movie production still, a memorable face, expressive profile and genuine beauty. Don't make this a concept art drawing. No coins, money symbols, floating data, HUD, neon grids, generic sci-fi dashboards, gimmicks, rendered text, brands, menus, trading charts or book covers.
